long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Phillip George trained as an accountant and built businesses supplying food to supermarkets and fast-food chains. He responded to customers' demand for consistent recipes and product quality, including items sold through supermarket salad bars.

When his daughter Gen proposed an online employment marketplace, he debated the idea with her during a flight to Melbourne. He became executive chairman and mentor at OneShift and Skilld, helping with negotiations and staffing questions while she led the businesses. The services connected local workers with employers needing staff quickly. Recruitment group Programmed invested in OneShift and took a seat on its board.
